parameters.command:
=set -eo pipefail
cd ~/workspace
# Extract GitHub token from the embedded remote URL (first-run.sh seeds it
# there), so git push works even when GH_TOKEN isn't in this SSH session.
export GH_TOKEN="$(git config --get remote.origin.url | sed -n 's|.*x-access-token:\([^@]*\)@.*|\1|p')"
export GITHUB_TOKEN="$GH_TOKEN"
if [ -z "$GH_TOKEN" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: could not extract GH_TOKEN from workspace remote URL — set GITHUB_TOKEN in release.env and restart the release-agent" >&2
  exit 1
fi
git fetch origin main --tags
git checkout main
git reset --hard origin/main
LATEST=$(git tag --list 'v*' --sort=-v:refname | head -1 | sed 's/^v//')
LATEST="${LATEST:-0.0.0}"
IFS='.' read -r MAJ MIN PAT <<<"$LATEST"
case "{{ $json.bump }}" in
  major) MAJ=$((MAJ+1)); MIN=0; PAT=0 ;;
  minor) MIN=$((MIN+1)); PAT=0 ;;
  patch) PAT=$((PAT+1)) ;;
esac
NEW="$MAJ.$MIN.$PAT"
echo "bumping $LATEST -> $NEW"
if [ -x ./scripts/sync-versions.sh ]; then
  ./scripts/sync-versions.sh "$NEW"
  git add -A
  git commit -m "release: v$NEW (PR #{{ $json.prNumber }})" || true
fi
git tag "v$NEW"
git push origin main --tags
echo "NEW_TAG=v$NEW"

parameters.body: =release-agent pushed {{ $json.stdout.split('NEW_TAG=')[1]?.trim() || '(see logs)' }} — GitHub Actions will build and publish.
